ai_analysis.second_order_effects: A severe legal setback could lead to a higher cost of funding if credit rating agencies revise their outlook, or trigger secondary class-action lawsuits from ADR holders or institutional investors.
ai_analysis.key_uncertainty: The exact legal basis, jurisdiction, and financial damages sought in the lawsuit are currently unknown.
